title: Cart details and bulk actions on demand (Labs)
blurb: In the Labs list builder, each row's details panel now shows the cheapest matching listings and exactly what the estimate priced, alongside owned quantity and target price; Escape closes it and puts focus back where you were. Ticking one or more rows reveals a bar with Set HQ, Any quality, Delete selected and Clear, and the column headers sort by name, quantity or estimated cost without moving a row you are still editing.
